summary: Tested iteration 13 (Birthdays: admin comment + new-employee flow + multi-birthday modal). Wrote pytest suite (5 tests, all passing) covering POST/GET/PATCH comment persistence and POST /admin/employees duplicate handling. Frontend Playwright E2E on admin dashboard verified add-dialog mode toggle, existing-mode shows all employees with 'has DOB' badges (150 present), new-employee mode creates user + birthday + comment, duplicate employee_number shows toast and keeps dialog open, edit preloads comment, comment persists after edit-only save. Then logged in as the newly created employee: BirthdayModal opened in MULTI view (2 today), rendered both cards with correct testids, showed 'N Birthdays Today' headline, no Prev/Next, single Close-multi button dismissed. Cleanup executed via admin API — no leftover data.
critical_code_review_comments: BirthdayEditor.jsx new-employee mode hard-codes the created user's password to the raw employee_number in plaintext (client.post('/admin/employees', {password: emp})). Backend hashes it, but this default (documented as 'password = Employee ID') should ideally prompt a password change on first login — reiterating the observation from iter12 bulk-import.

BirthdayEditor.jsx: `employeeChoices` slice(0,150) may silently hide matches when admin searches employees in existing-mode; consider an explicit 'showing 150 of N' hint or don't slice when a search term is present.
BirthdayModal.jsx: `useEffect` that plays cheer on open has an `open` dep only — ESLint may warn about missing `muted`/`playCheer`. Non-blocking.
AdminDashboard.jsx still at 1200+ lines; splitting per-tab was flagged in iter12 and remains open.
